title: Privacy: an erase warning the app cannot read is dropped, so the words may claim more was deleted than was
evidence: Follows S49. ios/HealthRoadmap/Engine/HealthEngine+Erase.swift CloudErase init(from:): warning falls back to nil, which is the no-warning value. The warning carries the Google Drive copy the erase left in place (packages/health-core/src/drive-rest.ts:316 ERASE_KEPT_COPY) or the reason an erase that landed then failed (record-session-erase.ts:150-153). No existing Swift string is true for every provider and cause as written. Drafted sentence for Brad's yes: "Some copies in <cloud> may not be deleted. Check <cloud> to be sure." Used when the reply carries a warning the app cannot read. US-25 AC16h, US-10 AC4a
